title: 香港文旅局长罗淑佩：黄金周客流预计增5%，节庆活动如何拉动消费？
speaker: Rosanna Law

segments.en: morning nice to see you again yeah I think the last book a few months ago so golden weeks coming up yep how many visitors are we expecting 1.29 million a five-percent increase over last year okay
segments.zh: 早上好，很高兴再次见到你。上次见面是几个月前了。黄金周即将到来，我们预计有多少游客？129万人次，比去年增长5%。

segments.en: that that's quite a bit this doesn't sound a big leap from last year but mind you just as you mentioned we had the meet often festival just now with the very nice international Lenten Fest
segments.zh: 这个数字相当可观。虽然听起来比去年增幅不大，但别忘了，正如你提到的，我们刚刚举办了中秋灯会，还有非常精彩的国际彩灯节。

segments.en: spectacular which is ongoing by the way into the golden week we got about 20% or more tourists visiting us over meet often festival then last year so some of them as you said strategically came a little bit earlier so we still expect a five percent increase of tourists over the golden week
segments.zh: 这个盛况会一直持续到黄金周。中秋灯会期间，游客量比去年增长了约20%甚至更多。所以有些人像你说的，策略性地提前来了。我们仍然预计黄金周期间游客增长5%。

segments.en: what are they here to do I mean are they spending I mean what is it that they're attracted to in terms of popular destinations we are actually quite optimistic because looking at the meet often festival
segments.zh: 他们来这里做什么？消费情况如何？哪些热门目的地吸引他们？我们其实相当乐观，因为从中秋灯会来看，

segments.en: our FMB the food and beverages industry they report a 20 to 30% growth over last year which is very encouraging retail sector also said that it's good looking good and I think the mood is festive here certainly into the golden week
segments.zh: 我们的餐饮业报告称比去年增长了20%到30%，非常令人鼓舞。零售业也表示情况良好。我认为这里的氛围很喜庆，尤其是进入黄金周。

segments.en: and we are going to have a lot of events for them we have the fireworks tomorrow we will have I know that a lot of our retail sector are having big promotional sales we also will continue with our Lenten Festival and then upcoming we will also
segments.zh: 我们为他们准备了很多活动。明天有烟花表演，我知道很多零售商家都在进行大型促销。我们还会继续举办彩灯节，接下来还有

segments.en: have Halloween celebrations in town in Hong Kong the whole month now is it it is a whole month I think it's three weekends climaxing into the end of October with our Wine and Time Festival this year we promise it to be bigger longer better so it's going to be a very busy season
segments.zh: 香港全城将举办万圣节庆祝活动，整整一个月。我认为有三个周末，在10月底达到高潮，还有今年的美酒佳肴节。我们承诺会更大、更长、更好，所以这将是一个非常繁忙的季节。
